title: Reaching Points
description: Determine if (sx, sy) can reach (tx, ty) by repeatedly adding one coordinate to the other.
pseudocode:
1: while tx > sx and ty > sy:
2:   if tx > ty: tx %= ty
3:   else: ty %= tx
4: return tx == sx and ty == sy or (tx == sx and (ty - sy) % tx == 0) or (ty == sy and (tx - sx) % ty == 0)

steps.note: Initialize starting point (2, 10) targeting (1, 1). Check loop condition.
Since ty (10) > tx (2), we subtract tx from ty via modulo.
Loop terminated. Check if target coordinates match the starting constraints.
